AWPTCM-T33314.objective:
• Classified traffic (matched by a class-map in a policy-map) has its DSCP value set as defined by the service-policy on egress.
  • The class set dscp action applies on switchport interfaces.
  • The class set dscp action applies on static LAG interfaces.
  • Matching traffic receives the configured DSCP marking; non-matching traffic falls to the default class behavior.
  • Configuration and marking behavior is verified on VCS master and backup nodes, after VCS failovers, and after reboot from saved config.
  • Show mls qos interface policer-counters and egress packet inspection confirm the expected DSCP values.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.

Create a class-map matching on DSCP (or other criteria). In a policy-map, set dscp value for the class. Apply the service-policy to a switchport interface. Send matching and non-matching traffic. Verify egress DSCP is set as configured for matching traffic.
Repeat the policy with class set dscp on a static LAG interface. Verify classified traffic DSCP marking on the LAG.
Verify behavior on VCS master and backup nodes.
Perform VCS failover and confirm the policy, class-map, and DSCP marking continue to function correctly.
Reboot and reload from startup config. Confirm the QoS policy with class set dscp is preserved and operational.
Inspect show mls qos interface policer-counters and capture egress packets to confirm DSCP values and counters for matching vs non-matching traffic.
